_description: Film presence gap analysis for issue #36. Documents the root cause of characters scoring 0 due to empty film corpus, and what can/cannot be determined from repo data alone.
_methodology: Cross-referenced screen_time_v2.json, output/corpus/*/screenplays/scenes.json, output/scores/kiro/*.json, and raw screenplay text across all sources (v1/v2/v3/merged).

screenplay_only_gaps._description: Characters with measured screen time in data/source/metrics who are NOT named in any screenplay source (v1, v2, v3, or merged). These characters are visibly on screen but cannot be detected from screenplay text alone.

characters.name: Ernie Prang
characters.evidence: screen_time_v2.json shows 1.0 min in PoA. grep -ri 'prang' across all four screenplay directories returns 0 matches. Character is the Knight Bus driver.
characters.reason_not_scorable: No screenplay text names this character. A non-speaking appearance provides no material against which faithfulness can be judged.

stale_scores._description: Characters that have film corpus (from v2 corpus rebuild) but whose kiro scores are stale from corpus_version 1 when they had empty corpus. These need rescoring, not a presence fix.
stale_scores.action: Rescore with current corpus. No data fix needed - this is a cache invalidation issue.

needs_client_confirmation._description: Characters with truly empty film corpus (0 scenes) AND no measured screen time. We cannot determine from repo data whether they appear on screen. Client must confirm which (if any) are visibly present in the films.
needs_client_confirmation._note: We deliberately refuse to assert film presence based on pretrained knowledge of film credits or casting. See issue #37 for why.
